mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers immediate risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 9.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-side recovery (INDPRO rising above 100.5 for two consecutive months), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 100.5, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) from prior month indicates monetary tightening during labor market slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises from prior month, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (quarterly GDP growth above 2.5% YoY), accelerating corporate earnings growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.
